# SingIt

> SingIt: pay for AI with USDC and keep spending limits. Your agent pays per call, only within the daily and per-purchase limits you sign: set them once, and your AI agent buys gift cards, eSIMs, top-ups and live answers inside those limits. Limits protect only SingIt's own agent: on Base they are enforced by an on-chain contract, on a SingIt API key the server checks them. On Solana, SingIt's server checks the daily and per-purchase limits; the chain only caps the total delegated.

Machine-readable discovery: https://ask.singitai.app (llms.txt, openapi.json, pricing.json, .well-known/x402, SKILL.md, .well-known/agent-card.json, llms-models.txt, llms-full.txt).

Agents with no wallet of their own: use an MCP key with limits your owner sets: https://singitai.app/docs/mcp-key/
Caps apply only to calls made with the key to SingIt's MCP and /v1 endpoint; they do not limit spending elsewhere or protect an agent's own wallet.
Developers who pay from their own wallet with @singitai/sdk (npm) or singit (PyPI) set required client-side ceilings, maxPerCallUsd and maxPerDayUsd, checked in their own process before anything is signed.
Free first call: POST https://ask.singitai.app/v1/chat/completions with model free/deepseek-v4.1-flash; no key or wallet, subject to the free allowance below.

Agent instructions: https://ask.singitai.app/SKILL.md
Discovery card (MCP, not an A2A task endpoint): https://ask.singitai.app/.well-known/agent-card.json

Aliases: POST /v1/models/<id>/chat or /images; ids at https://ask.singitai.app/llms-models.txt.

## Money rules for agents

Unpaid calls: HTTP 402 includes PAYMENT-REQUIRED (base64 JSON, x402Version 2). Decode it, sign one offer, retry the same request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Success: HTTP 200 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

`upto` is listed first: pay the actual cost up to the signed ceiling. `exact` is priced for a typical answer (~30% of max_tokens), settled at that flat price whatever length the answer turns out to be. Never sign above budget.

You pay the shown model price (metered by actual usage), plus a settlement fee of $0.001 on Base or $0.002 on Solana. Base and Solana share API URLs. Exa: its listed price plus a settlement fee of $0.001 on both Base and Solana. Route ranges are USDC; the request's 402 offer is authoritative.

Only billable answers charge; upstream 503s never charge. For 400/413/422, fix the request; do not switch models. 409: payment signature already used. For 503, wait Retry-After if supplied; for free-tier 429, wait Retry-After.

Free tier: 6 free models, 20 answers/day/network, shared daily cost cap $0.25. The shared cap may run out (free_budget_exhausted); resets at midnight UTC. No wallet or key required. Each free answer reports `billing.remainingToday`; when used up, drop the `free/` prefix to pay.

Paid /v1/chat/completions: 200 messages, 100000 estimated characters (tools included; 8000 per image), 64 tools/calls, four images, max_tokens 8192 (default 800), 128 kB JSON body. Model capabilities constrain tools/images. Messages/Responses support tools and 32000 output tokens.

Chat/Messages/Responses stream:true returns buffered SSE after settlement with billing and PAYMENT-RESPONSE. Chat ends with [DONE]; Responses with response.completed. Chat stream_options accepts only {include_usage:boolean} with stream:true. Free/per-model streams retain text-only limits; free refuses tools/images.

/numbers.json: aggregate traffic only.

Reference chat request: 1 message(s), 30 characters, 12 input tokens, max_tokens 800. Per-model reference prices are in the full models list, with upto before exact.

## What it is

Connect your wallet, sign daily and per-purchase limits, and let your agent buy gift cards, eSIMs, top-ups and answers on Base or Solana. Revoke with one signature.

## Products

- Web app at https://app.singitai.app/app/ — connect a wallet, set limits, let an agent spend inside them.
- SingIt Ask: https://ask.singitai.app — chat, Messages, Responses, images, speech and search; USDC per call on Base or Solana without an account. Guide: https://ask.singitai.app/llms.txt
- A remote MCP server at https://app.singitai.app/mcp (free tools without a key; a SingIt API key for paid tools).

## Start here: free, then a key, then MCP

"model":"singit/auto" on POST /v1/chat/completions picks eco/standard/premium for text prompts; min_tier sets the minimum. Before payment, seller refusal tries the next model in the tier or above. X-SingIt-Model and X-SingIt-Tier identify the answer.

fallback_models: paid pinned chat accepts 1–3 unique model ids excluding the pinned model and singit/auto. Before payment, an unavailable model can use the first healthy priced candidate with no higher Base upto ceiling, in the same auto tier where applicable. X-SingIt-Model and X-SingIt-Fallback-From identify the replacement.

1. Free: POST https://ask.singitai.app/v1/chat/completions with model "free/deepseek-v4.1-flash". One of 6 free models; 20 answers/day/network, shared $0.25/day cost cap. May run out (free_budget_exhausted); resets at midnight UTC. No wallet or key.
2. API key: in the SingIt app (https://app.singitai.app/app/), Settings → API keys. The wallet signs the key's limits (per day, per request, how many days); top up $1 to $50 at a time in USDC. With a key, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK and Claude Code work at https://app.singitai.app/v1 (shown model price, no per-call fee).
3. MCP: https://app.singitai.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP), official MCP Registry name app.singitai/singit.
   - Free, no key: get_price, list_price_symbols, list_models, chat_free.
   - Free with a key (read-only): get_balance, get_limits, get_allowance, get_receipts.
   - Paid per call from the key's limits (USDC on Base or Solana): chat, web_search, read_page.
   - Paid, Base accounts for now: get_x_profile, get_crypto_news, get_hyperliquid_market, get_funding_rates, resolve_ens, get_token_price; demo calls get_weather, get_singit_risk_check.
   - Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http singit https://app.singitai.app/mcp --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${SINGIT_API_KEY}'
     Single quotes keep ${SINGIT_API_KEY} as a reference so the key is not written into Claude Code's configuration.
   - Install guide: https://github.com/SingItAi/SingItAI/blob/main/llms-install.md
   - Tool reference (all 19 tools, parameters, scopes): https://singitai.app/docs/mcp-tools/

Own wallet: pay per answer over x402 at https://ask.singitai.app.

## First paid x402 call

1. POST https://ask.singitai.app/v1/chat/completions with no payment, e.g. {"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","max_tokens":200,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}. HTTP 402 supplies PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
2. accepts lists `upto` then `exact` on Base and Solana. `exact` is a flat price for a typical-length answer (about 30% of max_tokens). For Claude Opus, sign `upto`: its `exact` price carries room for thinking tokens and is usually dearer than the answer used (recommendedScheme in https://ask.singitai.app/pricing.json). USDC on Base needs no ETH (gas is sponsored).
3. Sign one offer and retry the same request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. HTTP 200 returns the answer, billing.totalAtomic in micro-USDC and PAYMENT-RESPONSE.
- Walkthrough with code (x402 fetch, Coinbase Bazaar MCP, Coinbase agentic wallet): https://github.com/SingItAi/SingItAI/blob/main/docs/first-paid-call.md

## Errors

JSON errors include a stable code: OpenAI-style error.code, Messages-format error.code, or a top-level code alongside a string error. Tolerate unknown codes. Reference: https://singitai.app/docs/errors/

A 402 challenge body includes x402Version and accepts, equal to the corresponding fields in the decoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, plus error: "payment_required" and code: "payment_required". A settlement-failure 402 has error, code, action and message, with no challenge header.

429s include Retry-After (seconds). Free-tier daily 429s and /v1/prices 429s include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (Unix seconds). Free-tier busy 429s have only Retry-After: 5. Prices use fixed minute windows and Retry-After: 60.

| HTTP status | code | meaning | charged? | what to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 400 / 413 | invalid_json, invalid_request, payload_too_large | Invalid JSON, input or body size | No | Fix request; reduce body for 413. |
| 401 / 403 | unauthorized, forbidden | Authentication or access refused | No answer charge | Check access. |
| 402 | payment_required, payment_unfunded, payment_blockhash_stale, payment_replay, payment_invalid | Payment challenge or refusal | Nothing was charged for this request on refusal | Inspect PAYMENT-REQUIRED; check budget before signing. Without a challenge, reconcile submitted payment. |
| 404 | model_not_found, not_found | Model, route or symbol unavailable | No | Check route or catalogue. |
| 409 | payment_duplicate, stale_payment_permit | Signature used or permit nonce stale | No new charge | Check original result; wait for settlement before signing a fresh permit. |
| 422 | max_tokens_too_small, invalid_request | No answer within output budget or invalid request | No | Fix request; raise max_tokens within budget. |
| 429 | rate_limited, free_tier_exhausted, free_budget_exhausted, free_tier_busy | Allowance exhausted or busy | No | Wait Retry-After. |
| 503 | no_billable_answer, no_healthy_sellers, upstream_unavailable | No billable answer or upstream unavailable | Never | Wait Retry-After where supplied, then retry. |

## Payment refusal codes

Refused payments keep error: "payment_required" and add a specific code, action and safe message, also exposed in X-SingIt-Error. Nothing was charged for this request, on Base or Solana: the x402 middleware holds the answer until settlement succeeds. Clients should treat payment_duplicate and payment_replay as the same condition.

- payment_unfunded: fund_wallet. Fund the wallet and its token account.
- payment_blockhash_stale: sign_again. On Solana, sign again with a fresh blockhash.
- payment_replay: check_previous_result. Check the previous result before paying again.
- payment_invalid: fix_payment. Fix the payment before retrying.

## Model pages with prices

singit/auto: POST /v1/chat/completions picks eco/standard/premium by simple rules for text prompts. Optional min_tier sets a minimum. X-SingIt-Model and X-SingIt-Tier report the choice. If the chosen model's seller refuses before payment, the router picks the next model of the tier or the next tier up, never below min_tier; after payment it retries once with another model of the same tier only if it costs no more than the price quoted, otherwise the request fails with 503 and no charge; X-SingIt-Model and X-SingIt-Tier show what actually answered. Prices depend on the chosen model; use the live 402 quote.

> Generated from models-snapshot.json; USD per 1M tokens is the listed SingIt price. Settlement fees are additional. Reference request prices are USDC per call; live 402 offers are authoritative.
